From PFD note | D-A800-02: 5 °C/min stated basis; REP-022 shows ≈ 4.5 h needed for heat-up plus cool-down — resolve.
Based on screw speed and fill factor | D-A800-02: 2 h (MEB-010, REP-019); REP-022 ramp inconsistency carried as follow-up.
